notes: Primary contact: CTO (Maj. Helen Ortiz, retired military) - 'cannot have any egress from classified zone'
SecOps: wants HSM-backed key wrapping and optional on-prem KMS with key zeroization policy
Compliance asks: STIG hardening, CIS benchmarks, full audit logs shipped to on-prem SIEM (Splunk) over internal network
Workload profile: mixed - interactive secure-chat for operator assist (~5k req/day), nightly embedding index build (8M docs), reranking for comms triage
Latency targets: 95p < 250ms for short-chat (max tokens 256) in SCIF; batch embedding throughput goal 50K tokens/sec during off-hours
Cost sensitivity: not price-first; procurement wants predictable committed monthly cost for Dedicated/Private with option to upsell support
Model preferences: open-weight Llama-family variants preferred, quantized where allowed. Customer insists on model provenance and ability to freeze versions
Routing: must support local-only routing and deterministic fallback to a smaller on-prem model; no cloud fallback permitted for SCIF workloads
Telemetry: customer will accept only aggregated telemetry exported to an internal observability endpoint; no PII or prompt text can leave air-gapped environment
Integration notes: must integrate with CMDB (ServiceNow), inventory tag required for each Redwood rack, labeling for ATO package
use_case_summary: Deploy private air-gapped Redwood instance inside a SCIF for operator assistance and comms triage. Primary goals: zero-egress, HSM-backed keys, model pinning, STIG/CIS hardening, deterministic fallback to smaller local models for resilience.
procurement_notes: Procurement wants three vendor quotes, DUNS + W9 on file, 60-day net payment terms requested. Legal requested a classified-data addendum. SOW needs to include install/validation and rollback procedures.
technical_requirements: Rack-level install in SCIF, isolated NTP/GPS, internal package mirror, no cloud dependencies, optional hardware HSM (Thales) provided by customer, OOB management via separate jump-host.
security_review_status: InfoSec completed initial checklist; pending third-party pen test and STIG checklist verification. Requested red-team run on POC instance before PROD signoff.
poc_scope: 3-week on-prem POC: baseline performance (latency/throughput), model pinning tests, HSM key wrap/unwrap, telemetry gating and SIEM forwarding, failure-mode tests (power loss, network isolation).
demo_feedback: Operators liked fast cold-start and deterministic fallbacks; raised concern about KV cache persistence — want explicit cache zeroization on shutdown.
customer_quotes: We need absolute assurance that nothing leaves the room — no telemetry that ties back to operators.
If Redwood can show an air-gapped install runbook and HSM integration, procurement moves fast.
notes_short: Air-gapped private POC for SCIF; high security bar; legal + procurement items blocking SOW signoff.
